title: Thai Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai chicken stir fry that can be made in under 30 minutes. Serve with steamed vegetables or rice.

ingredients.name: Rich Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality soy sauce for best flavor

ingredients.name: Kenyan Red Pepper Flakes
ingredients.notes: adjust to taste for spice level

ingredients.name: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and snow peas

ingredients.name: Cooking Oil
ingredients.notes: such as vegetable or peanut oil

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from wok and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add stir fry vegetables and cook until tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce, red pepper flakes, and chickpea flour (if using) to the wok and stir to combine.
Return chicken to the wok and stir to coat with sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
